notes:
- **Fix for the random crashes.** The app could crash unpredictably — jumping
  to the next episode, rating something, or just clicking around. We traced it
  to the graphics/UI engine the app was built with, which had been quietly
  updating to a brand-new version that turned out to be unstable. This release
  pins it back to the long-term stable version. If you'd been seeing random
  closes, they should be gone — please let us know if any remain.

---
Windows updates itself on the next launch. Linux updates through your system updater if you installed 2.6.8 or newer; if you are on an older version, download the `.deb` below and install it once more.
